2020 
Author: Rajendra Kumar Srivastava
Bench: Rajendra Kumar Srivastava
 1 Mcrc-34877-2019
 The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 Mcrc-34877-2019
 (Rajesh Gupta Vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others)
4
Jabalpur, Dated : 08-01-2020
 Shri Sankalp Kochar, Advocate for the petitioner.
 Shri Sharad Singh Baghel, P.L. for the respondent-State.
Issue notice to the respondent no.2 on payment of P.F. by both modes within a period of seven working days.
Notice be made returnable in two weeks.
Let it be made available on the next date of hearing, positively.
Heard on I.A. No. 15635/2019, which is an application for grant of stay.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that on 27.07.2019, complainant alongwith few other officers visited the factory of the applicant in the garb of ensuring compliance the provisions of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

The said team of officers alongwith the respondent no.2/complainant took the samples of certain raw materials as well as processed material from the factory and found as Sub-standard under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and registered an FIR No. 197/2019 at P.S.-Industrial Area, Satlapur, Distt.-Raisen under Section 272, 273 & 420 of IPC.

He submits that the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 is special enactment, which specifically deals with the offence of sub-standard product, thus, the penal provision of IPC do not apply in this matter.
complainant- respondent no.2 has not followed the procedure of law, as provided under Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
On these grounds, he prays for staying the further proceedings of the aforesaid First Information Report.

Considering the averments made in the application and the submissions made by the learned counsel for the applicant, the proceedings of the F.I.R. No.197/2019 registered at P.S.-Industrial Area, Satlapur, Distt.-Raisen under 2 MCRC-34877-2019 Section 272, 273 & 420 of IPC shall remain stayed till next date of hearing.
